name: asp-canary-smoke
description: Two of the default tasks, one trial each: a quick check that an agent still reads a file and follows a format. For gating changes in tests and demos; use the default suite for real decisions.

tasks.probes: uses a tool to read a fact and reports it
tasks.prompt: What is the name of the rollback owner? The answer is in facts.txt. Reply with just the name.

files.facts.txt:
The deploy window is Tuesday 14:00 UTC.
The rollback owner is Priya.

tasks.probes: follows an exact output format with no tools
tasks.prompt: Reply with exactly the single word OK and nothing else.
